question: Will ETH close above $2,500 on August 31?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH/USDT daily closing price on Binance on August 31, 2026 (UTC) is strictly above $2,500.
- "No": Wins if the ETH/USDT daily closing price on Binance on August 31, 2026 (UTC) is at or below $2,500.

Clarifications:
- The closing price is the last traded price of the ETH/USDT pair on Binance at 23:59:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (i.e., the close of the August 31 UTC daily candle).
